The Night Ken Jennings’ Streak Finally Ended

On November 9, 2004, Ken Jennings’ 74-game run on Jeopardy! came to a shocking end—defeated by Nancy Zerg.

After earning over $2.5 million, Jennings seemed unstoppable until a final clue miss stunned viewers.

He later returned to win more tournaments, cementing his legacy—but Zerg’s upset remains one of TV’s greatest. | Did You Catch This? | Facebook

Brought to life by Margaret Hamilton, her green face and eerie cackle became the stuff of childhood nightmares. But in a heartfelt moment, Fred Rogers invited Hamilton onto Mister Rogers’ Neighborhood to show kids the truth behind the character. Piece by piece, she revealed her costume and makeup, explaining how the scary witch was simply a role she played.
